script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The city has no night, but that does not establish that nobody is in darkness anywhere in the vision.
The sea being no more does not establish that there are no deep waters in the picture.
The quote begins with “I” without first identifying the One seated on the throne as the speaker.
“The verse says” does not identify the speaker before the quote uses “I.”
The quote uses “I” without first identifying the One seated on the throne as the speaker.
“All it asks for is thirst” adds an exclusivity to the offer that the verse does not state.
The passage does not say that stars would have nothing to do, or rule out starlight merely by saying there is no night in the city.
The foundations bear the apostles’ names, but the passage does not say none of those apostles are elders.
The passage places the throne inside the city and says His servants will worship Him. It does not say nobody is outside the walls.
The passage says the gates will never be shut at the end of the day. It does not say the city has no closing time at all or that it does not own a closed sign.
The verse says only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life enter. It does not discuss whether someone could gain entry by what they carry.
The passage says the angel carried John to a mountain, not that John stood there. It also does not say the river cannot flow from that mountain.
A fresh crop each month does not establish that the tree never runs out of fruit.
